_doc: Delo Derby board spec. The race: 8 fresh-start self-play training recipes, each raced in chunk_epochs-sized chunks to cap_epochs, scored by anchored model_elo. Allocation = Delo-rate priority queue (the not-yet-capped idea with the best most-recent elo gain gets the next chunk). Everyone reaches cap_epochs eventually; leaders get there first. Each idea changes ONE lever vs C0-baseline (clean attribution). All share --size small --seed 0 => identical fresh init. Engine: single-process gomoku.train (chunk = --resume <idea>/latest.pt --epochs <chunk_epochs>; --epochs is an INCREMENT). Score = last eval/model_elo in <idea_dir>/checkpoints/eval_results.jsonl. Curator/curriculum ideas are a FUTURE board (they need the train_replay flywheel engine, not fresh self-play).

ideas.name: C0-baseline
ideas.lever: control (sims 200, 64 games, 400 steps, buf 100k, temp 8, lr 1e-3)

ideas.name: sims-400
ideas.lever: n_simulations 400 (vs 200) - stronger policy targets, slower gen

ideas.name: sims-100
ideas.lever: n_simulations 100 (vs 200) - weaker targets, ~2x faster gen / more games per wall

ideas.name: buf-30k
ideas.lever: replay_buffer_size 30k (vs 100k) - faster turnover, fits recent self-play harder

ideas.name: open-div4
ideas.lever: random_opening_moves 4 (WL3 lever) - opening diversity, better-balanced climb

ideas.name: ema-099
ideas.lever: ema_tau 0.99 (WL2 lever) - EMA self-play weights, smoother targets
